items.known: CKV_AWS_46 Ensure no hard-coded secrets exist in EC2 user data (resource aws_instance.web_host)
items.remediation: Remove the hardcoded `export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, and `export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION` lines from the `user_data` attribute. Attach an IAM role to the instance using an `iam_instance_profile` attribute and manage secrets with AWS Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store instead of embedding them in `user_data`.

items.known: CKV_AWS_3 Ensure all data stored in the EBS is securely encrypted (resource aws_ebs_volume.web_host_storage)
items.remediation: Set the `encrypted = true` attribute on `aws_ebs_volume.web_host_storage`. Optionally add `kms_key_id` to use a customer-managed KMS key.

items.known: CKV_AWS_24 Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port 22 (resource aws_security_group.web-node)
items.issue: SSH ingress open to the internet
items.remediation: In the `ingress` block for port 22, replace `cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]` with a restricted trusted IP range such as your administrative CIDR, or remove the rule and use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager instead.

items.known: CKV_AWS_382 Ensure no security groups allow egress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port -1 (resource aws_security_group.web-node)
items.remediation: Restrict the `egress` block by limiting `from_port`, `to_port`, `protocol`, and `cidr_blocks` to only required destinations and ports instead of `protocol = "-1"` with `cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]`.

items.known: CKV_AWS_130 Ensure VPC subnets do not assign public IP by default (resource aws_subnet.web_subnet)
items.remediation: Set `map_public_ip_on_launch = false` on `aws_subnet.web_subnet` and place internet-facing resources behind controlled entry points such as a load balancer or bastion architecture.

items.known: CKV_AWS_130 Ensure VPC subnets do not assign public IP by default (resource aws_subnet.web_subnet2)
items.remediation: Set `map_public_ip_on_launch = false` on `aws_subnet.web_subnet2` and place internet-facing resources behind controlled entry points such as a load balancer or bastion architecture.

items.known: CKV_AWS_145 Ensure that S3 buckets are encrypted with KMS by default (resource aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket)
items.remediation: Add server-side encryption configuration to the bucket using an `aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration` resource for `aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket`, setting SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS as the default.

items.known: CKV_AWS_21 Ensure all data stored in the S3 bucket have versioning enabled (resource aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket)
items.remediation: Enable versioning by adding an `aws_s3_bucket_versioning` resource for `aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket` with `versioning_configuration { status = "Enabled" }`.

items.known: CKV2_AWS_6 Ensure that S3 bucket has a Public Access block (resource aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket)
items.remediation: Add an `aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block` resource for `aws_s3_bucket.flowbucket` with `block_public_acls = true`, `ignore_public_acls = true`, `block_public_policy = true`, and `restrict_public_buckets = true`.

scores.reason: Removes the secrets from user_data and attaches an IAM role via iam_instance_profile; this satisfies the check.
encrypted = true on the aws_ebs_volume is the correct fix, and kms_key_id is a reasonable optional addition.
Restricts the port 22 cidr_blocks to a trusted range or removes the rule, which fixes the check.
Right direction (restrict egress), but vague about specific values. Limiting ports/protocol or CIDRs would resolve it, but no concrete value is given.
map_public_ip_on_launch = false is the exact fix.
